canonical_title: Environmental control system status and fault indications

versions.title_at_revision: Environmental control system status and fault indications
versions.text:
Standard: The air system provides the means at the flight crew station to indicate ECS parameters, system faults, degraded system performance, and flight-critical equipment temperature limit exceedances. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings and flight crew interfaces to verify that ECS information is provided to the flight crew to monitor ECS performance and to notify of ECS failures, degradation, or flight-critical equipment temperature limit exceedances. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis, such as a SSHA and FMECA, to verify that ECS failures are identified. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct lab testing (e.g., HITL, FMET) or air vehicle simulations to verify that ECS information and notifications of ECS failures, degradation, and flight-critical equipment temperature limit exceedances are provided to the flight crew.
